Short title and date of operation
1. (1) This Act may be cited as the INLAND REVENUE (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 99 OF 2026.
(2) Subject to subsection (3), the provisions of this Act shall come into operation on April 1, 2026.
(3) The amendments made by sections 8, 9, 10, 31, 32, 33 and 34 shall apply for the year of assessment commencing on
April 1, 2026 and for every subsequent year of assessment unless otherwise provided.
Principal enactment
2. In this Act, the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017 is referred to as the “principal enactment”.
Words and expressions used in this Act and not defined herein shall, unless the context otherwise requires, have the
meanings assigned to them in the principal enactment.
 
3. Section 3 of the principal enactment is hereby amended by the insertion immediately after the definition of “digital
service” of the following definition: -
“digital productivity equipment” means computer equipment, electronic equipment, connectivity equipment or
other equipment prescribed for the purposes of a relief under the Fifth Schedule, which is used primarily in the
production of income.”
  is hereby amended in subsection (1) by the insertion immediately after paragraph
(c) of the following new paragraph: -
“(d) an amount derived from the provision of qualifying digital productivity services, to the extent that such
amount is required to be treated separately under this Act.”
